cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says judgments or case status are open to the public online. The Mahakim file-tracking page is dated only to 2026 and counts from the end of that year.
cells.note: Lawyers file briefs and appeals through a dedicated platform (MAR-003), and the national enforcement platform is in service and being extended (MAR-007). The public file tracking on Mahakim (MAR-005) carries only the year 2026, so it is not yet counted and the cell stays at 4.
